body.p: Favorable reconsideration of the Application is respectfully requested. I. Status of the Claims

Claims 1, 3, and 9-10 are pending. Claims 1 and 3 are amended, claims 2 and 4-8 are cancelled, and claims 9-10 are newly added. Support for the amendments can be found throughout the Application as originally filed, such as at least in Paras. [0136], [0141] and [0144] of the published Specification ("Specification"). No new matter is added.
II. Allowable Subject Matter

Applicant thanks the Examiner for indicating that claims 4 and 6-8 would be allowable if rewritten in independent form. As reflected in the foregoing amendments, claim 1 has been rewritten to incorporate all the features of claim 4. It is believed that claim 1, and claim 3 dependent therefrom, are in condition for allowance.
III. Rejections under 35 U.S.C. @@ 102/103
The Office has rejected claim 1 under 35 U.S.C. § 102 as being anticipated by JP2009126433 (A) to Kazuyuki ("Kazuyuki").
The Office has rejected claim 2 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Kazuyuki in view of US Patent Publication No. 2017/0154527 Al to Yoshitomi ("Yoshitomi").
The Office has rejected claim 3 and 5 under 35 U.S.C. § 103 as being unpatentable over Kazuyuki in view of US Patent Publication No. 2022/0340123 Al to Kameoka ("Kameoka").

Applicant respectfully disagrees. Nevertheless, without acquiescing thereto, and solely for purposes of expediting prosecution of the present application, Applicant hereby amends claim 1 to incorporate the features of allowable claim 4. Applicant respectfully submits that the cited art of record, whether alone or in combination, fails to disclose or suggest all the features of amended claim 1.

As acknowledged by the Office, the prior art fails to disclose or suggest at least the features of claim 4. See the Office Action at page 8. As the references of record, whether alone or in combination, fail to disclose all the features of independent claim 1, Applicant respectfully submits that claims 1 and 3 are in condition for allowance.
The Office is respectfully requested to reconsider and withdraw the rejections under 35 U.S.C. 102 and 103 to the claims.
IV. New Claims

With this Response, Applicant adds claims 9-10. Applicant respectfully submits that this claim recites no new matter and highlight other novel features. For example, Applicant respectfully notes that new claim 9 incorporates similar features as allowed in claim 4. Specifically, claim 9 recites: "assess accuracy of the map locator, and upon assessing the accuracy to be unfavorable, determine that it is the turn opportunity in a case where a turn signal for the first direction turn is detected to be ON and a vehicle speed of the vehicle is less than a predetermined threshold". Moreover, claim 10 recites other novel features, such as: in a case where it is determined that it is the turn opportunity, perform control to reduce acceleration to a target acceleration rate which is calculated by a first calculation method on a basis of at least a vehicle speed of the vehicle, before the turn steering is started, an in a case where it is determined that it is not the turn opportunity, perform control to reduce a target acceleration rate which is calculated by a second calculation method on a basis of a steering angle and the vehicle speed acceleration, after the turn steering is started". For at least these reasons, new claims 9 and 10 are allowable. Favorable examination is respectfully requested.

It is believed the application is now in condition for allowance. The Examiner is respectfully requested to contact the undersigned if there are any remaining issues which can be resolved by a Supplemental or Examiner's Amendment.

To the extent necessary, a petition for an extension of time under 37 C.F.R. § 1.136 is hereby made. Please charge any shortage in fees due in connection with the filing of this paper, including extension of time fees, to Deposit Account 201507 associated with Customer No. 6980referencing Attorney Docket No. 243410.000342 and please credit any excess fees to such deposit account.
Early and favorable examination is requested.
